bounded_objective: Replace the refuted per-reached-node associator sum by a consecutive-state event charge that vanishes on unchanged cylinders, and prove a sharp hierarchy payment on a nontrivial class.
prior_status: No finite constant controlled the literal hierarchy sum under pathwise nonreuse, even for three parallel affine cosets.
mathematical_delta: Defined the Doob associator decrement Gamma_v, proved exact telescoping with terminal correction 2p ln2, established Omega(s)<=4 ln2 I(s) for all three-parallel-coset sources, and obtained the sharp complete-tree bound sum w Gamma <=8 ln2 I(d).
remaining_obstacle: Show that the genuine biased coherent remainder equals the event-local decrement plus already paid alpha-log and endpoint terms, or bound its non-telescoping residual by one source/terminal reserve.
next_action: Rewrite the exact biased kernel identity between consecutive restriction states and isolate the residual after subtracting Gamma_v; test that residual on dummy cylinders, shared-coordinate witnesses, and sparse point defects.
